segments.title: Washington Treaty subjects in the series
segments.summary: The Washington Treaty schedule covers capital ships, aircraft carriers, other vessels and fortifications, followed by a proposed cruiser design and an overall treaty review.
segments.body: The Washington Treaty episodes on capital ships and aircraft carriers were already available when this outline was recorded. Other ships and fortifications were scheduled for 2 June. On 3 June, an Ultimate Admiral: Dreadnoughts (UAD) episode would explore a proposed Washington Treaty cruiser design. An overall equitable-treaty review was scheduled for 4 June.

evidence.note: The transcript lists the Washington Treaty installments, the proposed UAD cruiser design and the overall review on 4 June.

segments.title: London Treaty subjects and fleet categories
segments.summary: The London Treaty schedule covers capital ships, carriers, the Pensacola class, possible cruiser designs, destroyers, sloops, other vessels and fortifications, before an overall review.
segments.body: The London Treaty portion was scheduled to begin with capital ships under the first London Treaty on 5 June, followed by aircraft carriers on 6 June. A Pensacola-class episode on 7 June would open a separate series on US cruisers, followed on 8 June by possible London Treaty cruiser designs. Destroyers were scheduled for 9 June, and sloops and other ships for 11 June. An intervening Ultimate Admiral: Dreadnoughts (UAD) battle was still undecided: it could involve capital ships, cruisers, destroyers or a mixed force. Fortifications would follow on 12 June, with an overall equitable-treaty review on 13 June covering what remained.

evidence.note: The transcript lists the London Treaty installments, the Pensacola-class introduction to US cruisers and the undecided UAD battle between the destroyer and sloop episodes.
